 Fiorentina, reclaiming the Franchi: Vanoli eyes first home win since April 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article The win over Sassuolo has restored confidence around Fiorentina , but the road out of the crisis is still long. Against Juventus, the Franchi faithful are looking for a first home victory since April and a strong show of character. Fiorentina are hoping to build on their win over Sassuolo, a result that allowed Paolo Vanoli’s side to regain some composure after a particularly difficult start to the league campaign. 
 However, the three points secured last time out have not erased all the problems that emerged in the opening months of the season. Now they need to do more: build on those signs of improvement and prove that the team really has started moving in the right direction.
 OneFootball Videos
 Fiorentina are chasing a first home win since April: (Via Onefootball)-Fiorentinauno.com
 Fiorentina: the Franchi wants a win
 As Corriere Fiorentino points out, Fiorentina are showing some signs of life , but still only in patches. There were encouraging signs in the first halves against Inter and Como, and in the second halves against Atalanta and Sassuolo. What has been missing so far is the ability to deliver convincing performances over the full ninety minutes. Six defeats in the opening ten matches have inevitably dented confidence, fuelling concerns among supporters who once again find themselves facing a worrying league position.
 The match against Juventus therefore represents an important test , not just because of the quality of the opposition and the historic rivalry between the clubs. Fiorentina want to win again in front of their own fans, having gone without a home league victory since their 1–0 win over Lazio on April 13, and turn the Franchi into an ally. Vanoli knows just how much this match means and hopes the renewed enthusiasm from the Sassuolo game can provide an extra boost.
 The coach’s work is focused above all on finding balance . The squad has quality and talent, but has yet to find the right blend of attacking ability, covering space and willingness to work hard for the team. With that in mind, it will also be important to gradually bring back players such as Atta, who is expected to return after the break, and make the most of Gonçalves’s strengths without losing defensive cohesion.
 Vanoli also reiterated a point about identity:
 My goal is to teach the new players what Fiorentina is all about.
 Fiorentina vs Juventus is drawing ever closer: (Via Onefootball)-Fiorentinauno.com
 A message aimed at a squad that has yet to fully grasp what it means to wear the purple shirt. Winning is the quickest remedy, but it is not enough on its own . Against Juventus, they will need to deliver both in their play and in their character. Before the break, Vanoli wants to give the Franchi a night to celebrate and pick up valuable points to move further away from the relegation zone.
